pageHeader.title: Debug & Logs
pageHeader.description: Live diagnostics, recent history, and environment details for this panel

permissionDenied.title: You can't view debug diagnostics
permissionDenied.description: Your account's role doesn't include "View panel diagnostics". Ask an administrator to grant it if you need access to this page.

modsOrphanWorkshop.noteWithCount_other: Triages {{count}} Workshop items: enables downloaded mods, drops ignored/missing IDs. Restart required.
modsOrphanWorkshop.noteGeneric: Triages Workshop items: enables downloaded mods, drops ignored/missing IDs. Restart required.

modsMaps.label: Repair Map=
modsMaps.note: Removes invalid Map= entries and re-adds detected map folders. Restart required.

modsDuplicates.note: Removes duplicate Mods= entries. Restart required.

modsWorkshopCrash.label: Open Mods
modsWorkshopCrash.note: Re-check Workshop downloads and remove or replace the failing mod, then restart.

serverProcess.label: Start server
serverProcess.note: Starts the dedicated server using the active configuration.

serverActiveOrInstallPath.label: Open Servers
serverActiveOrInstallPath.note: Select or configure an active server with a valid install path.

serverZomboidData.label: Open Settings
serverZomboidData.note: Set the Zomboid data path in Settings.

serverStartScriptOrJre.label: Open Server Finder
serverStartScriptOrJre.note: Re-run server detection or reinstall the dedicated server files.

serverIniOrSandboxVars.label: Open Server Config
serverIniOrSandboxVars.note: Configure server settings to generate or repair the .ini files.

serverSandboxCorrupt.label: Repair SandboxVars.lua
serverSandboxCorrupt.note: Attempts an automated repair (missing block header/comma). A backup of the broken file is saved first. If the corruption doesn’t match a known pattern, nothing is written.

serverRconPassword.label: Open Server Config
serverRconPassword.note: Set the RCON password in Server Config (and matching value in Settings).

serverBridgeMod.label: Open Server Finder
serverBridgeMod.note: Re-deploy the PanelBridge mod via Server Finder.

serverConfigDrift.label: Open Server Config
serverConfigDrift.note: Reload the panel’s config from server.ini, or push your changes back to disk.

serverStaleLocks.label: Delete stale lock files
serverStaleLocks.confirmMessage:
This will delete every *.lock file older than 1 hour in the active save folder. The server must be stopped first.

Proceed?
serverStaleLocks.note: Stops the server is NOT automated — make sure the server is stopped first. Then deletes stale .lock files.

serverRecentCrash.label: View crash logs
serverRecentCrash.note: Opens the Crash Logs tab on this page for the latest stack trace.

rconConnected.label: Reconnect RCON
rconConnected.note: Tries to reconnect to RCON using the saved password. If it still fails, check that the password in Server Config matches Settings, then restart the server.

servicesStuck.label: Open Settings
servicesStuck.note: Restarting the panel usually clears stuck services.

discordBot.label: Open Discord
discordBot.note: Check the bot token and intents in Discord settings.

bridgeConfigured.label: Auto-configure bridge
bridgeConfigured.note: Points the panel at the active server’s bridge folder and starts the watcher. The game server must then be running with PanelBridge.lua installed.

bridgeWritableOrHeartbeat.label: Open Server Finder
bridgeWritableOrHeartbeat.note: Re-deploy PanelBridge, ensure the server is running, and check write permissions on the bridge folder.

dbExistsOrWritable.label: Open Settings
dbExistsOrWritable.note: Verify the data directory path exists and the panel can write to it.

dbBackup.label: Create database backup
dbBackup.note: Creates a manual database backup right now. Schedule recurring backups from the Backups page.

logsWritable.label: Open Settings
logsWritable.note: Verify the logs directory path exists and is writable.

diskFree.label: Open Backups
diskFree.note: Free up disk space — delete old backups or clean unused chunks.

storageSaveSize.label: Open Chunk Cleaner
storageSaveSize.note: Trim the save by removing unreachable chunks.

runtimeHeapOrHostMem.label: Open Settings
runtimeHeapOrHostMem.note: Restarting the panel reclaims heap. Close other processes if host RAM is exhausted.

runtimeTimeSkew.label: Show recommended fix
runtimeTimeSkew.note: Sync the host system clock (NTP / Windows Time service) and re-run diagnostics.

updatePanelOrError.label: Open Settings
updatePanelOrError.note: Panel updates are managed from Settings → Updates.

updateMods.label: Open Mods
updateMods.note: Review and apply Workshop mod updates from the Mods page.

updateSteamApi.label: Show recommended fix
updateSteamApi.note: Verify outbound internet access to api.steampowered.com.

common.restartHint: Restart the server to apply the changes.

notFound.message: No {{pattern}} in install path. Server can't be started from the panel.

linux.message: Could not locate jre64/bin/{{javaBin}} under the install path. Server may fail to start unless system Java is on PATH.
linux.hint: Most installs ship a JRE under jre64/. Re-run SteamCMD if missing.

windows.message: Could not locate jre64/bin/{{javaBin}} under the install path. Server may fail to start unless system Java is on PATH.
windows.hint: Re-run SteamCMD to restore the bundled JRE

warn.label: server.ini not found
warn.message: {{serverName}}.ini is not in <zomboidData>/Server/. The server will create defaults on first run.

warn.label: RCON password not set
warn.message: No RCON password configured. RCON commands will fail.
warn.hint: Servers → Edit → RCON Password (must match server.ini)

ok.label: RCON password configured
ok.message: RCON password is set in panel config.

ok.label: PanelBridge mod present
ok.message: PanelBridge.lua is deployed on the server.

warn.label: PanelBridge mod not detected
warn.message: Couldn't find PanelBridge.lua under the server. Advanced features (teleport, weather, character export) will be unavailable.

oom.label: Recent crash: Out of memory
oom.hint: Raise the server's Java heap (-Xmx in the start script) or reduce mod count.

workshop.label: Recent crash: Workshop install crash
workshop.hint: Open the Logs page and read the stack trace around the timestamp.

mainException.label: Recent crash: Uncaught main-thread exception

fatal.label: Recent crash: FATAL log entry
fatal.hint: Open the Logs page and read the stack trace around the timestamp.

fail.label: SandboxVars.lua is corrupt
fail.message: {{serverName}}_SandboxVars.lua has mismatched braces and will fail to load — the dedicated server exits immediately on boot with a Lua syntax error.
fail.hint: Use the automated repair below, or restore from a .bak backup in the same folder.

warn.label: SandboxVars missing
warn.message: {{serverName}}_SandboxVars.lua not found. Server will boot with built-in defaults; any custom sandbox tuning will be ignored.
warn.hint: Open Server Config → Sandbox to generate one, or copy from another server.

fail.label: Stale lock files in save folder
fail.message: {{count}} .lock file(s) older than 1 hour in {{dir}}. PZ will refuse to load the save until they are removed.
fail.hint: Stop the server, delete every *.lock file under the save folder, then restart.

warn.label: Could not fully check for stale lock files
warn.message: {{dir}} is too large to fully scan for stale lock files within the diagnostics time budget. Stale lock files may be present but undetected.
warn.hint: Run "Delete stale lock files" to scan and clear in one pass -- it gets a much larger time budget than this automatic check -- or check the save folder manually if the server won't boot.

withOutput.label: Bundled JRE failed to run

withoutOutput.label: Bundled JRE failed to run

skip.label: Mod heartbeat
skip.message: Server is offline — heartbeat resumes when it starts.

stale.label: Mod heartbeat stale
stale.message: Last heartbeat {{age}}. Mod may have crashed or be unloaded.
stale.hint: Check server console.txt for PanelBridge errors

never.label: No mod heartbeat
never.message: status.json has never been written. Mod is not loaded on the server.
never.hint: Verify PanelBridge is in the server's mod list and Workshop subscription

warn.label: Bridge checks errored
warn.message: Bridge IPC checks could not run: {{reason}}

fail.label: Workshop mod download failed — server boot aborted
fail.message: {{count}} Workshop item(s) could not be downloaded and the server crashed during install (last log update {{ageLabel}}). Failing ID(s): {{idList}}. Likely delisted, made private, or region-restricted.
fail.hint: Open Server Config and remove the failing ID(s) from both WorkshopItems= and Mods=, then restart.

warn.label: Workshop download warnings
warn.message: {{count}} Workshop item(s) recently failed to download but the server did not crash (last log update {{ageLabel}}). ID(s): {{idList}}.
warn.hint: Verify each ID is still public on the Steam Workshop, or remove it from the server config.

warn.label: Workshop IDs misplaced in Mods=
warn.message: {{count}} numeric Mods= entries look like Workshop IDs, not mod folder names: {{list}}. These belong in WorkshopItems= and will never load from Mods=.
warn.hint: Remove these from Mods= and add them to WorkshopItems= instead.

ok.label: Mods= entries all resolve
ok.message: {{count}} mod(s) listed, all match an installed Workshop or local mod ID.

fail.label: Mods= entries do not resolve
fail.message: {{count}} of {{total}} Mods= entries don't match any installed Workshop or local mod ID: {{list}}.
fail.hint: Usually a typo, missing WorkshopItems= ID, or the mod hasn't finished downloading. Fix in Server Config.

both.label: Subscribed Workshop items not enabled
both.message: {{count}} Workshop item(s) listed in WorkshopItems= but won't load: {{downloadedCount}} downloaded but not in Mods=, {{deadCount}} not on disk (dead subscription). IDs: {{list}}.
both.hint: Auto-fix triages each ID: downloaded → resolves and adds to Mods=; ignored or missing → removes from WorkshopItems=.

downloadedOnly.label: Subscribed Workshop items not enabled
downloadedOnly.message: {{count}} Workshop item(s) listed in WorkshopItems= but won't load: {{downloadedCount}} downloaded but not in Mods=. IDs: {{list}}.
downloadedOnly.hint: Auto-fix triages each ID: downloaded → resolves and adds to Mods=; ignored or missing → removes from WorkshopItems=.

deadOnly.label: Subscribed Workshop items not enabled
deadOnly.message: {{count}} Workshop item(s) listed in WorkshopItems= but won't load: {{deadCount}} not on disk (dead subscription). IDs: {{list}}.
deadOnly.hint: Auto-fix triages each ID: downloaded → resolves and adds to Mods=; ignored or missing → removes from WorkshopItems=.

both.label: Duplicate mod entries
both.message: {{dupModsCount}} duplicate Mods= entries, {{dupWsCount}} duplicate WorkshopItems= entries in the server config.
both.hint: Tidy up Server Config — duplicates can confuse mod-load order.

modsOnly.label: Duplicate mod entries
modsOnly.message: {{dupModsCount}} duplicate Mods= entries in the server config.
modsOnly.hint: Tidy up Server Config — duplicates can confuse mod-load order.

workshopOnly.label: Duplicate mod entries
workshopOnly.message: {{dupWsCount}} duplicate WorkshopItems= entries in the server config.
workshopOnly.hint: Tidy up Server Config — duplicates can confuse mod-load order.

both.label: Map= entries do not resolve
both.message: {{count}} Map= entries cannot be found. {{modsInMapCount}} of them are actually mod names, not maps (they only belong in Mods=): {{modsInMapList}}. {{trulyMissingCount}} not found in any installed mod: {{trulyMissingList}}.
both.hint: Remove mod names from Map=, and add the matching map mod or fix spelling for the rest.

modsOnly.label: Map= entries do not resolve
modsOnly.message: {{count}} Map= entries cannot be found. {{modsInMapCount}} of them are actually mod names, not maps (they only belong in Mods=): {{modsInMapList}}.
modsOnly.hint: These names are mods, not maps. Remove them from Map= — they only need to be in Mods=.

missingOnly.label: Map= entries do not resolve
missingOnly.message: {{count}} Map= entries cannot be found. {{trulyMissingCount}} not found in any installed mod: {{trulyMissingList}}.
missingOnly.hint: Players will spawn into the void. Add the matching map mod or fix the spelling in Server Config.

warn.label: No active server
warn.message: No server is currently active in the panel. The map will load tiles but cannot show players, vehicles, or safehouses.
warn.hint: Servers → select one and click “Set active”.

fail.label: B42 tile CDN unreachable
fail.message: Could not reach tiles.pzmap.org for B42 tiles ({{detail}}). The B42 base map will not load.
fail.hint: Check the panel host's outbound HTTPS access. The /api/map/tiles proxy fetches tiles server-side.

warn.label: B41 tile CDN unreachable
warn.message: Could not reach tiles.pzmap.org ({{detail}}). B41 fallback tiles will not load.
warn.hint: Only relevant if you run a B41 server. Outbound HTTPS to tiles.pzmap.org is required.

fail.label: B42 top-down tiles unavailable
fail.message: Build {{build}} did not serve a .{{format}} top-down tile ({{detail}}). The Map Cleanup page will show chunks with no base map.
fail.hint: Upstream may have republished this build in a different image format. Re-run diagnostics after a few minutes; the panel re-reads the format from base_top/layer0.dzi every 24h or on restart.

warn.label: B42 top-down format unresolved
warn.message: Could not read base_top/layer0.dzi to determine the top-down tile format.
warn.hint: Check outbound HTTPS access from the panel host.

warn.label: Tile reachability probe failed
warn.message: Tile probe could not complete: {{reason}}

ok.label: B42 build auto-detect healthy
ok.message: Build {{build}} was resolved dynamically from the map service.
ok.hint: Resolution depends on an upstream bot-detection heuristic outside the panel's control, which has been observed responding inconsistently to identical requests. Treat this as working right now, not permanently solved -- it can start failing again with no change on the panel's side.

warn.label: B42 build auto-detect failed
warn.message: Using hardcoded build {{build}} because discovery failed: {{reason}}. This will not track the next PZ map build until discovery starts working again.
warn.hint: Discovery asks the map service which build is current, using the system's curl. Landing here means that request did not succeed — curl is missing, the panel has no outbound network access, or the map service refused the request. The first two are worth checking on your side; the third may not be fixable from the panel. Watch for this after a Project Zomboid map release, since that is when a stale build shows up as wrong map geometry.

fail.label: Tile proxy needs Node 18+
fail.message: AbortSignal.timeout is unavailable on this runtime. Every tile fetch will throw and return 502.
fail.hint: Upgrade the panel host to Node 18+ (the bundled .exe already ships with this).

fail.label: PanelBridge not configured
fail.message: The map gets live player positions, vehicles and safehouses from PanelBridge. Without it, the map will show only the static base tiles.
fail.hint: Configure the active server's Zomboid Data Path so the bridge folder can be located.

warn.label: PanelBridge service not running
warn.message: The bridge service is configured but not currently polling. Live map data will be empty.

warn.label: Mod not connected
warn.message: PanelBridge is running but the in-game mod has not written status.json yet. Players, vehicles and safehouses will not appear.
warn.hint: Start the PZ server and confirm the PanelBridge mod is in the active mod list.

warn.label: Mod heartbeat stale
warn.message: Last status.json update was {{ageSeconds}}s ago. Live map data may be stale.

withHeartbeat.label: Live data feed healthy
withHeartbeat.message: PanelBridge running, mod connected, last heartbeat {{ageSeconds}}s ago.

info.label: No save found yet
info.message: No save folder under <zomboidData>/Saves. The server hasn't generated a world yet — the map will still render but without chunk data.

b42.label: B42 save detected
b42.message: {{saveCount}} save(s); using {{saveName}} for build detection (map/X/Y.bin layout).

b41.label: B41 save detected
b41.message: {{saveCount}} save(s); using {{saveName}} (map_X_Y.bin layout). Map will switch to B41 tile source.

warn.label: Save build not detected
warn.message: Found {{saveCount}} save folder(s) but couldn't identify B41 vs B42 layout. Map will default to B42 origin and player coords may render off-screen on a B41 save.
warn.hint: Start the server once to materialise chunk files.

warn.label: No Zomboid data path set
warn.message: Cannot locate save folders. Map auto-detection of B41/B42 will be skipped.
